_comment: This is a GitHub repository ruleset, not something GitHub applies just by being committed. To activate it: Settings -> Rules -> Rulesets -> New ruleset -> Import a ruleset -> upload this file (or paste its contents) -> Create. Requires repo admin. Rulesets aren't reachable via this repo's current GitHub App/token scope, which is why this is committed as a spec instead of applied automatically.
name: main-branch-protection
